reviews.name: aniyan unni
reviews.quote: We are very happy with the decoration arrangements for our daughter's wedding engagement event at Udaya Resort AC Hall. The stage decoration, entrance décor, and welcome counter were all completed on time and met our expectations.

reviews.name: Viswanath R V
reviews.quote: ​We hired Elegant events for our wedding reception decor, and they did a fantastic job! Everything looked incredibly neat, well-executed, and exactly as planned. Their pricing was fair and completely in line with our expectations. On top of that, they were super punctual and handled every task on time with zero hiccups.
